title: Ask for more
story: Your AlphaFold job needs {{gpus}} GPUs and {{mem}} GB of memory. Start an interactive session with exactly that.

lesson.title: Asking for several GPUs and more memory
lesson.intro: Each option asks for one kind of resource. Add one for every resource the job needs. For example:

parts.note: 2 GPUs, only for you. Programs in the job see exactly these 2.
48 GB of RAM for the whole job. `G` is gigabytes. Use more than this and Slurm kills the job.
An interactive shell inside the job.

lesson.why: Slurm reserves exactly what you ask for. Big structure predictions need several GPUs and a lot of memory, and the GPUs and memory you hold can't go to anyone else until you `exit`. In this course each student can hold at most 2 GPUs and 48 GB at a time.
lesson.without: Leave out `--mem` and you get the default, 16 GB for each GPU, so a big job runs out of memory. Ask for more than Geiss-01 can give a job (8 GPUs, about 174 GB) and Slurm refuses: "Requested node configuration is not available".

tasks.text: Start an interactive job with {{gpus}} GPUs and {{mem}}G memory

hints: `--gres=gpu:N` sets GPUs and `--mem=NG` sets memory: `srun --gres=gpu:{{gpus}} --mem={{mem}}G --pty bash`.
